verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase offers a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console. The docs say it generates queries, mutations and schemas, deciphers error messages, analyzes logs, and gives Crashlytics crash root causes and fixes. That covers writing queries and debugging errors directly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that it explains the user's own backend configuration (docs only mention answering general questions about Firebase products), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain my backend

citations.quote: shorten your troubleshooting process with new insights from Gemini in Firebase using a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console
Use Gemini in Firebase to generate schemas, queries, and mutations on-demand using natural language.
Gemini in Firebase can decipher error messages and provide clear explanations and mitigations. It can also analyze logs
AI assistance provides actionable insights into your app's crashes, including a full description of the issue, information about possible root causes, and suggestions on how you can fix the issue.
